tooltip.tkgun.armor_part.c1: C1 chestplate module. Only one module of each class can be installed.
tooltip.tkgun.armor_part.c2: C2 chestplate module. Only one module of each class can be installed.
tooltip.tkgun.armor_part.c3: C3 chestplate module. Only one module of each class can be installed.
tooltip.tkgun.soul_chain.chain: Attacks have a 35% chance to chain through targets within 5 blocks for 70% and 50% damage.
message.tkgun.shield_blocked: Left Pauldron blocked the attack; 2 second cooldown
tooltip.tkgun.mechanician_undersuit: Accessory-slot undersuit. Replaces the player body below the head and grants 3 armor.
tooltip.tkgun.mechanician_chestplate: Chestplate and cloth drapes. Requires the Mechanician Undersuit.
tooltip.tkgun.mechanician_leggings: Mechanician leg armor. Requires the Mechanician Undersuit.
tooltip.tkgun.mechanician_boots: Mechanician boots. Requires the Mechanician Undersuit.
tooltip.tkgun.portable_launcher.storage: Occupies the offhand as launch storage. Only fireworks, tipped arrows, wind charges, and tridents can be stored.
tooltip.tkgun.portable_launcher.ammo: Swap from a launchable main-hand item; a finished cooldown restores all 3 charges.
tooltip.tkgun.portable_launcher.trajecto: Backpack projectiles fall at one-third gravity; Loyalty tridents return to the offhand first.
tooltip.tkgun.auto_portable_launcher.sto: Uses fireworks from the offhand to attack visible targets automatically.
tooltip.tkgun.auto_portable_launcher.att: Press the action key to activate or stop; fires and highlights every second, switching targets after two shots.
tooltip.tkgun.auto_portable_launcher.cha: Has 10 charges, restores 1 per second, and enters a 10-second cooldown when depleted.
tooltip.tkgun.abyssal_ancient_cannon.des: An ancient cannon recovered from a lightless ruin and rebuilt to fire the Mechanician's ammunition.
tooltip.tkgun.veritas_et_justitia.descri: A siege weapon named for truth and justice, unfolding to pass judgment on its targets.
tooltip.tkgun.bowgun.description: A weapon rebuilt from siege engines used against great fortresses. A trained wielder can use this powerful siege weapon with extreme mobility to traverse the battlefield.
tooltip.tkgun.bolt.effect: Full-charge throw; 2-block horizontal piercing radius; cannot be enchanted; focus interval x2
tooltip.tkgun.rose_quartz_bolt.effect: Locks onto a target within 6 blocks ahead and begins homing with a trail; a highlighted backpack target with clear line of sight takes priority until the highlight ends
tooltip.tkgun.armor_piercing_bolt.effect: 8-pellet cone; 12-block range; 10% velocity loss per block; 5-block cone radius; 2.5-block damage radius; focus interval 80%
tooltip.tkgun.summon_antenna.deploy: Press the action key to deploy; marking is locked until deployment finishes.
tooltip.tkgun.summon_antenna.mark: After deployment, press the action key to mark a nearby entity within 20 blocks of the crosshair.
tooltip.tkgun.summon_antenna.cast: Press again to summon a Molten Golem; without a target it appears up to 8 blocks along the crosshair.
tooltip.tkgun.missile_box.install: Installs below the Jump Backpack Thruster and requires it to be active.
tooltip.tkgun.missile_box.mark: Hold the action key to mark one visible target every 0.05s, up to 6.
tooltip.tkgun.missile_box.fire: Release to alternate cold-launched fireworks from both sides; each ignites and tracks after about 2 blocks. 6 second cooldown afterward.
tooltip.tkgun.war_banner.install: Installs in the backpack turret slot and occupies the offhand.
tooltip.tkgun.war_banner.skill: Press X while on the ground and not holding a gun to deploy the banner.
tooltip.tkgun.war_banner.aura: Allies within 8 blocks gain Absorption and Strength for 15 seconds; 60 second cooldown afterward.
tooltip.tkgun.jump_backpack_thruster.act: Replaces the upper-right launcher module. Press jump while grounded to climb to three blocks.
tooltip.tkgun.jump_backpack_thruster.ste: Then boosts forward. Hold jump to climb as high as six blocks.
tooltip.tkgun.jump_backpack_thruster.res: Thrust drains energy and falling restores it; depleted energy must fully recharge before another launch.
hud.tkgun.summon_antenna.dormant: Summon Antenna: press X to deploy
hud.tkgun.summon_antenna.armed: Summon Antenna: press X to mark
